title: Prompt caching se AI prompts 73% saste - 4 simple steps
content:
Same AI agent, same model, ek bhi word change nahi kiya, aur prompts 73% SASTE ho gaye.
Ye result Werk naam ki team ne publish kiya hai, ek chhote recipe agent pe real API ke saath test karke.
Cache reads 0% SE 94% tak gaye, sirf 4 changes mein.
Aaj main wo 4 steps aapko dikhata hoon, taaki aap apne AI app pe lagaa sako.
First, let's understand what prompt caching is.
Har baar jab aap AI ko call karte ho, aap poora prompt dobara bhejte ho. Tools, instructions, conversation, sab.
Provider prompt ki shuruaat ka kaam save kar leta hai, aur agla prompt same tarah shuru ho toh use reuse karta hai.
The rule is short. The cache reuses everything up to the FIRST THING THAT CHANGES.
Aur ye discount chhota nahi hai. OpenAI ke docs kehte hain cached input up to 95% discount pe milta hai, aur supported models pe caching by default on hai.
Ab 4 steps. Pehla step sabse easy hai.
Step 1. Jo cheez har message pe badalti hai, jaise date ya time, use prompt ke END MEIN daalo.
Unki testing mein sirf isse cache reads 0% se 65% ho gaye.
Step 2. User ki personal details shared instructions mein mat rakho. Unhe user message mein bhejo.
The instructions should be the same text for everyone.
Step 3. Har plan ko same tool list do. Free ho ya Pro.
Kaun kya use kar sakta hai, ye aapka code decide kare, prompt nahi. Isse unka cache 80% tak gaya.
Step 4. When a tool result comes back, do not rebuild the prompt. Just add it at the end, as the last block.
Maan lo aapke chatbot ka system prompt 1,000 words ka hai, aur din mein hazaron messages aate hain.
Agar wo hissa cache se aaye, toh har message pe aap sirf naye part ka poora price doge.
Mera take simple hai.
Model change karne se pehle prompt ka ORDER THEEK KARO. It is the cheapest optimization you will ever make.
